title: Bride and Groom with Vintage Car, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An overexposed black-and-white snapshot capturing a newly married couple posing next to a post-WWII era automobile. The bride is clad in a traditional white gown and veil, while the groom stands beside her in a classic dark tuxedo decorated with a white boutonniere. The tropical foliage and palm tree silhouetted in the background point to a warm-climate region such as California or Florida. The scalloped, deckle-edge paper border was a popular finishing style for photo prints during the late 1940s and early 1950s.
